title: ホープフルSの後に・進む覚悟

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a satisfactory victory in the G1 Hopeful Stakes, King Halo announces her intention to continue on to the Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tour can only be attempted once, making the competition fierce. She'll be pressed to win three races: the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And thus, King Halo's next goal is the first of the Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.
